tavily_vs_exa.note: Exa is primary discovery; Tavily is topic=news supplement plus extract. They are not interchangeable. Publisher quality is taken from the original URL.

top_10_facts.fact: Apple reported fiscal 2026 second quarter revenue of $111.2 billion, up 17 percent year over year.
Apple's fiscal 2026 second quarter diluted earnings per share was $2.01, up 22 percent year over year.
Apple's March quarter generated over $28 billion in operating cash flow.
Apple's fiscal 2026 second quarter ended March 28, 2026.
Pre-orders for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max begin Saturday, September 12, 2026 at 5 a.m. PT.
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are powered by the A20 Pro chip.
Apple announced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on September 9, 2026, featuring a 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture.
Apple introduced iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, on September 9, 2026, with a 7.6-inch inner display and 5.4-inch outer display.
iPhone Duo is powered by the new A20 Pro chip.
Apple's software updates including Siri AI rolled out starting September 14, 2026 across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27.
